public_rationale: Photoroom is a serious potential counterexample: reporting calls it profitable, and its own disclosure confirms internal model development. However, the profit measure is unspecified, and Photoroom also allows third-party models. Treating internal model development as proof of no external model use would strengthen Zitron’s wording beyond what it says. The available records and unspecified accounting basis do not permit a definitive score under these rules.
limitations: Unresolved does not endorse either universal assertion.
A broader reading of AI startups or a narrower reading of model dependence could change the assessment.

our_interpretation: Read AI startups primarily as the application businesses described in the surrounding value chain. The later inclusion of OpenAI and Anthropic makes the category boundary uncertain.
Use calendar 2025, the latest completed annual financial period before publication, for the ongoing profitability assertion.
Profitable ordinarily means company-wide income exceeds expenses, rather than positive gross margin, revenue growth or financing proceeds.

The model clause does not explicitly say exclusively third-party models. Developing an internal model alone therefore does not refute the literal claim that a startup also offers a service using externally supplied models.
criteria.support_condition: Comprehensive evidence shows that all in-scope startups incurred company-wide losses and all offered services using models supplied by AI labs.
criteria.contradiction_condition: One clearly in-scope startup is demonstrably profitable on a comparable accounting basis during the target period, or one has no service using models supplied by AI labs.

evidence.explanation: The article explicitly describes Photoroom as profitable, making it a material potential counterexample. No net-income figure, accounting basis or full-year result is provided; accessible primary financial statements were not obtained.

Photoroom develops models for strategic uses, challenging a reading that all application startups merely resell external models. The same section permits third-party models for non-core features, so it does not establish a counterexample to the literal external-service clause.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Comparable company-wide financial results for an in-scope profitable startup, with the claim’s accounting basis clarified, or a dated disclosure establishing an in-scope startup’s complete independence from externally supplied lab models.
